commit_message:
fix: keep recipe keys reci does not model, safe step ids, matrix number spelling (#49, #54, #56, #43 part)

Step and job keys without recipe meaning (timeout-minutes, shell, concurrency, ...) and
workflow-level defaults/concurrency/permissions were silently dropped; they are now emitted
(config refs rewritten, CONF004 checked, workflow-level ones refused as no needs context).
Derived step ids avoid every explicit id; duplicate explicit ids are refused. Matrix numbers
keep their spelling (3.10). List-valued runs-on no longer crashes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
